# SPEEDX AUTO

Official website: https://speedxrental.com

SPEEDX AUTO is a Richmond, British Columbia automotive business with two primary service areas:

1. Turo vehicle hosting and fleet management for Metro Vancouver and qualifying British Columbia vehicle owners.
2. Mechanical repair and maintenance in Richmond near Vancouver International Airport, serving customers across Metro Vancouver.

- Turo car hosting: https://speedxrental.com/en/hosting
